title: StartServiceResponse
description: Station response to a StartServiceRequest, indicating whether the service was successfully started.

status.description: Result of the start service request.

errorCode.description: Numeric error code. Present when status is Rejected.

errorText.description: Machine-readable error name in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Present when status is Rejected.

programNumber.description: ECHO of the programNumber from the request. REQUIRED when status is Rejected, so the operator reading the rejection can see WHICH ordinal was refused without correlating against the request. Matter requires the refused path be echoed in every CommandStatus, and MDB's Remote Vend SELECTION DENIED carries the item number it refused; Modbus omits it, and that omission is the documented reason Modbus debugging is painful.
